entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kazimierz Jan Paweł Sapieha was a grand hetman of Lithuania commencing in 1682. In 1681, he became Field Hetman of Lithuania, the following year he also became the voivode of Vilnius. He held the title of duke starting in 1700.
